organizations.name: EcoRoots
organizations.tagline: Planting trees and creating community park gardens.
organizations.description: EcoRoots helps students and community volunteers plant native trees, clean up local parks, and create urban gardens. When you start a local chapter, HQ sends you saplings, gardening tools, and guidelines to organize local events.
customQuestions: What specific parks or public areas in your city need tree planting?
Have you organized campus or community events before?
How many volunteers do you estimate you can gather for your first event?

branchGuide.curriculumOverview: Step-by-step tree planting guide and workshop templates for volunteers.
branchGuide.legalSupport: Official non-profit tax exemption status and city planting permit help.
branchGuide.guidelines: Official chapter resources, meeting agendas, and event guides.

organizations.membershipRequirements: Open to all enrolled students and local community members.
membershipQuestions: What specific projects or initiatives in our cause area interest you most?
What previous volunteering or campus club experience do you bring?

organizations.name: CodeNova
organizations.tagline: Free weekend coding clubs for middle and high school students.
organizations.description: CodeNova connects college students with local public schools to teach kids how to code games and apps. Chapters receive lesson plans, laptop grants, and mentor training.
customQuestions: What programming languages are you comfortable helping beginners with?
What schools or community centers in your city could host sessions?
Are you able to mentor on weekend mornings?

branchGuide.curriculumOverview: 10 beginner-friendly coding lessons in Python and Web Design.
branchGuide.legalSupport: School partnership agreements and background check support.
branchGuide.guidelines: Official chapter resources, meeting agendas, and event guides.

organizations.name: MindBridge
organizations.tagline: Peer support and mental health wellness circles for youth.
organizations.description: MindBridge runs student-led listening groups and wellness workshops on high school and college campuses to reduce stress, loneliness, and mental health stigma.
customQuestions: Why is peer mental health support important to your campus or community?
Have you taken any active listening or peer counseling training?
What wellness activities would you like to organize?

branchGuide.curriculumOverview: Training guide on active listening, empathy, and crisis resources.
branchGuide.legalSupport: Guidance from licensed counselors and crisis escalation protocol.
branchGuide.guidelines: Official chapter resources, meeting agendas, and event guides.

organizations.name: HarvestShare
organizations.tagline: Rescuing surplus dining hall food for local family shelters.
organizations.description: HarvestShare volunteers collect extra prepared meals from university cafeterias and bakeries and safely deliver them to local community food pantries.
customQuestions: Do you have access to a vehicle or transport for weekly food pickups?
Which local shelters or pantries would receive the food?
What days/times work best for your volunteer shifts?

branchGuide.curriculumOverview: Food safety standards and donation transport protocols.
branchGuide.legalSupport: Good Samaritan Food Donation Act protection and donor agreements.
branchGuide.guidelines: Official chapter resources, meeting agendas, and event guides.

organizations.name: CivicPulse
organizations.tagline: Non-partisan voter education and youth town halls.
organizations.description: CivicPulse helps students register to vote, understand local town hall issues, and host debates on community improvements without any partisan bias.
customQuestions: What campus or neighborhood spots are best for voter registration tables?
How will you maintain strict non-partisan balance?
What local issues do youth in your area care most about?

branchGuide.curriculumOverview: Guide to running non-partisan voter drives on campus.
branchGuide.legalSupport: 501(c)(3) non-partisan compliance guidelines and voter registration forms.
branchGuide.guidelines: Official chapter resources, meeting agendas, and event guides.

organizations.name: Sanctuary Health
organizations.tagline: Free basic health screenings and first aid training for neighborhoods.
organizations.description: Sanctuary Health trains pre-health students to host free blood pressure checks, CPR demos, and community health fairs in underserved neighborhoods.
customQuestions: Are you or your team pre-med, nursing, or public health students?
What community center or church could host your screening fair?
Have you received CPR or basic first aid certification?

branchGuide.curriculumOverview: Standard procedures for community screening fairs and CPR demos.
branchGuide.legalSupport: Medical oversight policies and patient consent forms.
branchGuide.guidelines: Official chapter resources, meeting agendas, and event guides.

posts.title: 50 Native Cedar Saplings Planted at Ravenna Park!
posts.content: Huge thank you to the 45 student volunteers from UW who joined us this Saturday morning. We successfully planted 50 native cedar trees and cleaned up 12 bags of litter along the creek trails!

posts.title: Fall Coding Workshop Series Kicks Off at Berkeley Public Library
posts.content: Our first 10-week cohort of middle schoolers just built their first interactive Python games today! Laptops and snacks funded by CodeNova's semester grant.

opportunities.title: Founding Chapter Lead - Austin & Central Texas
opportunities.description: Establish an EcoRoots branch in Austin. Mobilize students and community volunteers for urban tree canopy planting and local park cleanups with official toolkits.

opportunities.title: Founding Branch Director - Boston Metro & Cambridge
opportunities.description: Launch a CodeNova youth coding branch in Boston. Coordinate free weekend Python and Web development workshops for middle and high school students.

opportunities.title: Founding Chapter Lead - Ann Arbor & University of Michigan
opportunities.description: Create a welcoming peer wellness chapter at the University of Michigan. Host decompression circles, peer listening lounges, and mental health awareness panels.

opportunities.title: Founding Chapter Director - Atlanta Metro
opportunities.description: Establish a food rescue branch in Atlanta. Partner with campus cafeterias and local bakeries to transport surplus meals to community food pantries.

opportunities.title: Founding Chapter Lead - Seattle & UW Campus
opportunities.description: Launch a non-partisan youth civic engagement chapter in Seattle. Host voter registration drives, policy roundtables, and youth town halls.

opportunities.title: Founding Branch Director - Chicago South Side
opportunities.description: Lead a student healthcare outreach branch in Chicago. Coordinate free preventive health screenings, blood pressure clinics, and hygiene supply drives.

opportunities.title: Youth Python & Web Coding Instructor
opportunities.description: Teach introductory Python, HTML/CSS, and game logic to middle school cohorts. Guide students through building their first interactive coding portfolio projects.

opportunities.title: Urban Tree Planting Logistics Lead
opportunities.description: Coordinate weekend sapling distribution, permit checks with city park departments, and volunteer tool staging for community planting days.

opportunities.title: Peer Support Facilitator & Workshop Creator
opportunities.description: Facilitate weekly virtual student decompression circles and assist in developing stress-management workshop modules guided by counseling advisors.

opportunities.title: Food Recovery Dispatch Coordinator
opportunities.description: Schedule volunteer drivers, map pickup routes between donors (dining halls, bakeries) and shelter pantries, and track pounds of food rescued.

opportunities.title: Youth Civic Policy Research Analyst
opportunities.description: Draft non-partisan policy briefs on local housing, education, and voting access for high school and collegiate discussion roundtables.

opportunities.title: Community Health Triage & Outreach Volunteer
opportunities.description: Assist volunteer physicians and nurses at mobile weekend health clinics with patient check-in, vitals logging, and multilingual health resource translation.
